description: Extract generated version of the file from the compiled catalogue

option.name: Number of Builds to Retain
option.help: Number of builds to retain; older builds are automatically deleted

option.name: Number of days the version is retained
option.help: The number of days left in the version will be automatically deleted after the number and number of days reserved

option.name: Number of Versions Reserved
option.help: Number of reservations in the version that exceed the number of days and the number of reservations will be automatically deleted

option.name: DB Directory
option.help: Subdirectories to store SQL scripts in databases (relative directory relative to project catalogues, leave blanks on: db/ ${VERSION})

option.name: DOC Directory
option.help: Subdirectories to store documents (relative directory relative to project directory, leave blank representation: doc/${VERSION})

option.name: Package Artifact Extension
option.help: For non-coded projects, depressive extraction of zip packages, etc., may be possible, e.g.: zip, tar, tgz, tar.gz

option.name: Exclude Directory
option.help: Exclude subdirectories, commas separated, and do not sync these subdirectories

option.name: Generate MD5
option.help: md5 checksum (normally not required, unless required by the client)

option.name: Ensure file exists
option.help: Error if the extracted list is empty or the file does not exist

argument.name: Extract List
argument.help: Files or directories taken from project catalogues, e.g.: target/*.war or target/*.war:webapp/
